title: RNA Extraction Protocol for Aurantiochytrium limacinum
author: Michael Horowitz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bffgjjjw
materials: NEB Monarch Total RNA Miniprep Kit
Use NEB Monarch Total RNA Miniprep Kit from here. All centrifugation steps should be carried out at 16,000rcf.

steps.title: Prepare Aurantiochytrium limacinum preculture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 ml of 790 medium with a colony of Aurantiochytrium limacinum (ATCC MYA-1381) 4 days prior to extraction.

substeps.instruction: Incubate overnight at 28 C and 171 rpm.

steps.title: Culture cells
steps.instruction: Inoculate 20 ml of 790 medium in a 250 ml flask using the preculture.

substeps.instruction: Culture for three days at 28 C and 171 rpm.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Determine the volume of culture required to reach 5*10^7 cells via cell count and harvest the cells.

substeps.instruction: Place the required volume into a microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm for two minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Freeze cell pellet
steps.instruction: Place the cell pellet in liquid nitrogen for 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 750ul Trizol lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Incubate on ice for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

steps.title: Phase separation
steps.instruction: Add 150ul chloroform to the pellet in a fume hood and let sit for 2 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4C.

steps.title: Recover aqueous layer
steps.instruction: Pipette the upper aqueous layer into a sterile microcentrifuge tube on ice.

steps.title: Prepare RNA for column
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of >95% ethanol to the upper aqueous layer and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture from the microcentrifuge tube to an RNA purification column placed in a collection tube.

steps.title: Initial column wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.

substeps.instruction: Add 500ul RNA Wash Buffer and spin for 30 seconds.

steps.title: DNase treatment
steps.instruction: Prepare a DNase mixture in a separate RNase-free microcentrifuge tube by combining 5ul DNase 1 (Monarch Kit) with 75ul DNase 1 Reaction Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Pipette the mixture directly onto the column matrix.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Post-DNase washes
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to clean the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Add 500ul RNA Priming Buffer, spin for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through.
Add 500ul RNA Wash Buffer, spin for 30 seconds, and discard flow-through.
Add another 500ul RNA Wash Buffer and spin for two minutes.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new RNase-free microcentrifuge tube and elute the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 30ul of Nuclease-free Water directly to the column matrix and spin for 30 seconds.
Pipette the flow-through back into the column matrix and spin again for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Remove the column matrix, close the microcentrifuge tube, and label it.

substeps.instruction: Store eluted RNA at -20C for short-term storage or -80C for long-term storage.
